g.text: I11 copy the labels to the pull request:
blocked, the pull request failed the check,
the head commit moved, or a required
the fix requests are at the limit
the required checks do not report in time
comments left at the round limit,
I12 merge on the Owner's approval:
the Owner approved the head commit,
I13 request a response to the Owner's review:
First line of an arrow: the step of cumin (a row of issue-states.md).
An arrow without a row: the Owner, or the Planner, acts.
"check the review" is one step after a Reviewer run; today it is five rows.
